title: Foldable Emergency Toilet – Compact for Camping & Car
descriptionHtml:
A toilet when there isn't one

On long car trips, at festivals and out in nature, there isn't always a toilet nearby. It can be both uncomfortable and stressful, especially with kids.

Unfold when you need it

This emergency toilet folds flat and takes up almost no space. When it's needed, you unfold it in a moment – perfect to keep in the car or backpack.

Features

  • Foldable and compact
  • Easy to carry along
  • Durable plastic that lasts
  • Great for car, camping and festivals
  • Easy to clean

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
